ns2:course.label: Design for Manufacturability
ns2:course.description: Introduction to design-for-manufacturability methodologies and tools; quality management (Taguchi, productivity function deployment, statistical process control, etc.); materials selection (new and traditional materials); designing for primary manufacturing processes (cutting fundamentals, casting, forming, and shaping); designing with plastics (snap-fits, integral hinges, etc.); design for assembly; design for inspection and metrology (datums, geometric tolerancing, and inspection equipment); computer-integrated manufacturing. Prerequisite: ME 170; credit or concurrent registration in ME 330.
